title: WeatherCore: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe WeatherCore loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Craft or find a weather radio or scanner, read the current profile, and avoid starting long trips under worsening conditions.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first weather habit is checking conditions before leaving base and delaying a long route when the forecast already says the trip is becoming expensive.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves WeatherCore is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
